messages:
marta: heads up — starting a backfill for seeded prefix telemetry across prod clusters (us-east1 / eu-west1). Found a gap where seeded prompts weren't tagged with route_id in the 2026-02 window. This skewed token-saved totals by ~30% for a few tenants.

kevin: rough numbers? which dashboards were affected?

marta: quick sample: tenant=acme-corp, model=redwood-1.3q, route=/chat.v1 — saved tokens originally reported 120M for Feb; backfill suggests +35M. I'm going to run a targeted query and patch the ingestion pipeline.

lia: can you paste the query you'll run? want to validate the join keys and normalization we're using.

marta: here's the BigQuery snippet I'll run to backfill the aggregated view:
```
SELECT route, model, tenant_id, SUM(tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved
FROM `prod_telemetry.prefix_hits`
WHERE event_time BETWEEN TIMESTAMP('2026-02-01') AND TIMESTAMP('2026-02-28')
  AND seed_flag = true
GROUP BY route, model, tenant_id
ORDER BY tokens_saved DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

alex: thanks. note that we saw a regression where trailing whitespace + inconsistent case produced distinct prefix keys in the extractor (PR #4781). That probably explains the fragmentation.

marta: yep. I'll include a key_normalizer step in the backfill script (trim + lowercase + collapse-multi-spaces) and re-run the prefix-hitrate extractor on the affected shard set.

ops-bot: deploy-check — ingestion-updater v2.1 queued to canary at 2761234575 :white_check_mark:  

kevin: dashboard impacts — which panels should we refresh after the backfill? we need per-model / per-route / per-tenant token-saved views and the heatmap.

marta: panels to refresh: Dashboard "Prefix Savings — Telemetry Backfill": Panel 3 (top tenants), Panel 7 (model breakdown), Panel 12 (route heatmap). Temp link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/abc123/prefix-savings-backfill?orgId=1

lia: alerting question — should we pause the "drop in hitrate" pager while the backfill runs? otherwise SRE will get noisy alerts.

kevin: yes — mute alerts during the backfill window. ops-bot can you mute policy `prefix-hitrate-drop` for 2h starting now?

ops-bot: done — muted policy prefix-hitrate-drop until 2761237775 :lock:  

marta: estimated runtime ~45m per cluster for the backfill. After it's done I will post before/after CSVs and update per-tenant token-saved totals in the dashboard. Owner: marta. Reviewers: alex, lia, kevin. Action items: (1) run backfill with normalizer, (2) re-run dashboard queries and refresh panels, (3) kick off a small eval to ensure no perf regressions from the normalizer.

alex: please add a perf test to the job to ensure normalizer doesn't spike CPU for hot tenants — run with sampling=1% on the prod stream and record p95 CPU over a 10m window.

lia: noted. I'll add sampling to the backfill job and include a trace/span for KV cache miss/hit rates pre/post-normalization so we can correlate hit-rate deltas.

kevin: thanks all. ping when the panels are refreshed and if any tenant totals change materially so we can notify CS.

marta: will do — starting backfill now (kicking off cluster us-east1).
